reason: Alert 1 (xss) is a False Positive. User input flows to the sink, but the code wraps the output in HTML comment delimiters ('<--- ... --->') and strips the closing delimiter ('-->') from the input via param.replace('-->', ''). This ensures the resolved sink value is always a valid HTML comment, which browsers do not execute. Consequently, the content is safe from XSS attacks.
